title: Goblin (European folklore)
description: Folklore record: the small, mischievous household-and-wild creature of medieval European tales.

title: Hobgoblin
description: Folklore record: the friendlier goblin of English folklore — Robin Goodfellow and the helpful household spirit.

title: Kobold
description: Folklore record: the German mine-spirit and household sprite — namesake of cobalt.

title: Redcap
description: Folklore record: the murderous goblin of the Anglo-Scottish border, who dyes his cap in blood.

title: Brownie
description: Folklore record: the helpful Scottish household spirit who works for food and flees from payment.

title: Gremlin
description: Folklore record: the 20th-century goblin — RAF pilots' saboteurs of aircraft, born in World War II.

title: Imp
description: Folklore record: the small demon-servant of European tales — mischief in miniature.

title: Duende
description: Folklore record: the goblin of Iberian and Latin American lore — household trickster and forest guardian.
